card.name: Enzyme systems and drug-effect phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside drug-interaction phrases about metabolism, such as 'microsomal enzyme system', 'biological half-lives', 'hepatic metabolism' and 'action of'. It fires on the noun just before the text says which drug or process is affected.

modes.label: Enzyme system nouns
modes.description: The word system or systems ending 'enzyme system' in liver-metabolism statements.
modes.example: diphenoxylate hydrochloride was found to inhibit the hepatic microsomal enzyme<< system>> at a dose of 2 mg/kg

modes.label: Effect or half-life nouns
modes.description: Nouns like action, toxicity, metabolism or biological after 'the' or 'hepatic' in interaction statements.
modes.example: Probenecid may prolong or enhance the<< action>> of oral sulfonylureas and

card.plain: It marks the middle of phrases about how a drug is processed or how its effect is changed, just before the affected item is named.
